newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli jets raid Hizbollah posts in south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli jets raid Hizbollah posts in south Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli warplanes on Sunday raided suspected Hizbollah guerrilla targets just north of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone, security sources said.

They said the jets fired rockets into Jabal Safi in Iqlim al-Toufah a mountain ridge used by the pro-Iranian fighters to launch attacks against Israeli and allied militia forces in the border buffer zone.
There was no immediate word on casualties or damage in the air attack, the 20th into Lebanon this year.
In Israel, the army said in a statment that air force planes attacked "terrorist targets" in the morning in Jabal Safi area.
"The pilots reported accurate hits and all planes returned safely to base," the statement added.
The air raid came two days after one Israeli soldier was killed and one wounded when Hizbollah guerrillas shelled their post in the zone on Friday.
Four Hizbollah fighters were killed in those clashes. Hours later Israeli planes raided Hizbollah targets north of the zone but no one was hurt.

Hizbollah (Party of God) is fighting to oust 1,000 Israeli troops and their 3,000 South Lebanon Army militia allies from the 15-km (nine-miles)-deep south Lebanon zone the Jewish state said it set up to prevent raids on its northern border.
